title: PI Objectives — conveyor buildout, tranche 4
body:
# PI Objectives — conveyor buildout, tranche 4

The six objectives of tranche 4, their planned business value and the measurement that decides
whether each was met.

## Objectives

- **O1.** The tranche-4 record sets are evidenced and their manifests green; T9 and T10 first.
- **O2.** The seven deep-review findings are packages and their fixes land.
- **O3.** The v1 verdict is re-executed at the head; every gap is packaged.
- **O4.** The CODE P0 and P1 bundles execute with a commit and a named test.
- **O5.** The pack is republished from the live rows; coverage 74/74; viability re-run.
- **O6.** The next tranche is prepared only where the record supports it.

## Business value

O1 10, O2 9, O3 8, O4 7, O5 6, O6 5. The committed set is O1–O4 (34 of 45 planned points); O5 and
O6 are stretch items for the tranche.

## Measurement

- O1: `verify-project.py --project T9|T10` exits 0 at the tranche snapshot; the pi-plan,
  pi-objectives and lesson checks pass.
- O2: every `dr-w3-*` package is closed or named open with its acceptance command; the two record
  writes are read back through their actions.
- O3: `verify-slices.py --all` publishes the table; the table's own negative self-test proves a
  failing gate is reported absent.
- O4: each closed CODE package names a commit ancestor and a real test; the register's open CODE
  count falls.
- O5: `generate-standards.py --check`, `check-standards-coverage.py --check`, `publish-data.sh`
  strict and `verify-viability.py` are re-run at the head.
- O6: no artefact is generated from rows that do not exist; the handoff names the next batch.

## Evidence

- Cadence `01a202a1-dbb9-7e49-b64a-cf97c3fab095`; the approved plan gate on this cadence.
- The v1 findings ledger at `docs/evidence/v1-conformance-findings.json` (188 findings, 110
  resolved) and the deep-review sidecar.
- The clean replay journal and the board commit `bf41733f`.

## Risks

- R2 record theatre: a section resolving thinly is not evidence; the deep review samples it.
- R10 v1 quality unknown: the verdict table may find real work; that is the instrument working.
- R13 evidence theatre: every claim here is read back from the record, not asserted.
